column4: CHECKLIST ITEM
Clearly understand the goal of the email (e.g. informational / action required / urgent alert)
Determine who the email is coming from (e.g. specific executive / team alias / no-reply address)
Confirm the requested date and time for the email to go out
Understand exactly who needs to receive this (e.g. all employees / specific departments / external partners)
Pull the recipient list from the appropriate database or directory
Ensure the list accurately reflects the target audience requested
Remove anyone who should not receive the email (e.g. contractors / people on leave / previous opt-outs)
Confirm the total number of recipients matches expectations
Ensure the list is in BCC (if manual) or the mass-mailing tool is configured correctly to protect recipient privacy
Ensure it is clear / concise / and accurately reflects the email's urgency and content
Verify the short summary text (if supported by your sending tool) is optimized
Run a thorough spell-check and grammar check
Ensure the tone is appropriate for the audience and the message is easy to understand
If an action is required, verify the CTA is prominent and instructions are clear
Click every hyperlink in the draft to ensure they go to the correct / active pages
Verify that any required attachments are included / are the correct version / and are not too large (consider linking to a hosted file instead)
Ensure fonts are standard / colors have high contrast / and any images have alt-text
Have a second set of eyes review the draft for blind spots or typos
Send the final draft and recipient criteria to the original requester for sign-off
(If applicable) Route highly sensitive or external communications through the necessary legal or corporate comms channels
Send a test version to yourself and the requester
View the test email on both a computer and a mobile device to ensure formatting doesn't break
Verify the email is readable if the user has Dark Mode enabled
Queue the email for the approved date and time / or hit send
Confirm the email successfully left the outbox or sending platform
Check for delivery failures and update the contact list if necessary
Keep an eye on the reply-to inbox for the first hour to catch any immediate questions or out-of-office loops
(Optional) Provide the requester with confirmation of send and any relevant metrics (open rates / click rates) if using an analytics tool
